answer: Each agent identity is registered in dune, a Merkle state tree, with sonnet as its ZK-attestation circuit and raven as the consensus contract. A TPM/SGX quote binds code, key, and measured hardware; forging one identity requires compromising hardware or producing a valid enclave signature. The contract enforces an O(N^2) bonding curve, so Sybil identities require quadratic capital, while equivocation irreversibly slashes collateral.
